scope: Inline-media scaling audit and fixture-only migration validation

databaseSnapshot.limitation: Point-in-time after the load, not evidence of resource levels during the failure

checks: Upload unchanged bytes to owner-specific content-addressed private object
SHA256 and byte-length readback before metadata update
CAS by row ID, owner and updated_at

limits: Historical pg_stat_statements aggregates span prior deployments; cannot attribute them to latest failure
The failed mixed-load fixtures used short image URLs; inline images do not explain those measured failures
Installed-client compatibility and bulk rollout/rollback procedure remain required before migrating existing customer rows
Migration utility operates on explicitly supplied rows and has no implicit bulk apply
